system.description:
The character has been conditioned via timeaccelerated behavioral control psychosurgery. This is common among ex-felons, who have been conditioned to respond to a specific idea or activity with vehement horror and disgust, but may have occurred for some other reason or even been self-inflicted. At Level 1, the chosen behavior is either limited or boosted, at Level 2 it is either blocked or encouraged, and at Level 3 it is expunged or enforced (see p. 231 for details). This trait should only be allowed for behaviors that are either limited or, if encouraged, impact the character in a negative way.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 150.
